# Data Source: stripe_payment_method_configuration

Which payment methods are offered and how.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_payment_method_configuration" "checkout" {
  id = stripe_payment_method_configuration.checkout.id
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

* `id` - (Required) The ID of the payment method configuration to read.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `acss_debit` - See [`acss_debit`](#acss_debit) below.
* `active` - Whether the configuration can be used for new payments.
* `affirm` - See [`affirm`](#affirm) below.
* `afterpay_clearpay` - See [`afterpay_clearpay`](#afterpay_clearpay) below.
* `alipay` - See [`alipay`](#alipay) below.
* `alma` - Alma is a Buy Now, Pay Later payment method that offers customers the ability to pay in 2, 3, or 4 installments. See [`alma`](#alma) below.
* `amazon_pay` - See [`amazon_pay`](#amazon_pay) below.
* `apple_pay` - See [`apple_pay`](#apple_pay) below.
* `application` - For child configs, the Connect application associated with the configuration.
* `au_becs_debit` - Stripe users in Australia can accept Bulk Electronic Clearing System (BECS) direct debit payments from customers with an Australian bank account. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/au-becs-debit) for more details. See [`au_becs_debit`](#au_becs_debit) below.
* `bacs_debit` - See [`bacs_debit`](#bacs_debit) below.
* `bancontact` - Bancontact is the most popular online payment method in Belgium, with over 15 million cards in circulation. [Customers](https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers) use a Bancontact card or mobile app linked to a Belgian bank account to make online payments that are secure, guaranteed, and confirmed immediately. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/bancontact) for more details. See [`bancontact`](#bancontact) below.
* `billie` - Billie is a [single-use](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods#usage) payment method that offers businesses Pay by Invoice where they offer payment terms ranging from 7-120 days. Customers are redirected from your website or app, authorize the payment with Billie, then return to your website or app. You get [immediate notification](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods#payment-notification) of whether the payment succeeded or failed. See [`billie`](#billie) below.
* `bizum` - See [`bizum`](#bizum) below.
* `blik` - See [`blik`](#blik) below.
* `boleto` - Boleto is an official (regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil) payment method in Brazil. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/boleto) for more details. See [`boleto`](#boleto) below.
* `card` - Cards are a popular way for consumers and businesses to pay online or in person. Stripe supports global and local card networks. See [`card`](#card) below.
* `cartes_bancaires` - See [`cartes_bancaires`](#cartes_bancaires) below.
* `cashapp` - See [`cashapp`](#cashapp) below.
* `crypto` - See [`crypto`](#crypto) below.
* `customer_balance` - See [`customer_balance`](#customer_balance) below.
* `eps` - See [`eps`](#eps) below.
* `fpx` - Financial Process Exchange (FPX) is a Malaysia-based payment method that allows customers to complete transactions online using their bank credentials. Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM), the Central Bank of Malaysia, and eleven other major Malaysian financial institutions are members of the PayNet Group, which owns and operates FPX. It is one of the most popular online payment methods in Malaysia, with nearly 90 million transactions in 2018 according to BNM. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/fpx) for more details. See [`fpx`](#fpx) below.
* `fr_meal_voucher_conecs` - Meal vouchers in France, or “titres-restaurant”, is a local benefits program commonly offered by employers for their employees to purchase prepared food and beverages on working days. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/meal-vouchers/fr-meal-vouchers) for more details. See [`fr_meal_voucher_conecs`](#fr_meal_voucher_conecs) below.
* `giropay` - See [`giropay`](#giropay) below.
* `google_pay` - See [`google_pay`](#google_pay) below.
* `grabpay` - GrabPay is a payment method developed by [Grab](https://www.grab.com/sg/consumer/finance/pay/). GrabPay is a digital wallet - customers maintain a balance in their wallets that they pay out with. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/grabpay) for more details. See [`grabpay`](#grabpay) below.
* `ideal` - See [`ideal`](#ideal) below.
* `is_default` - The default configuration is used whenever a payment method configuration is not specified.
* `jcb` - JCB is a credit card company based in Japan. JCB is currently available in Japan to businesses approved by JCB, and available to all businesses in Australia, Canada, Hong Kong, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States, and all countries in the European Economic Area except Iceland. Check this [page](https://support.stripe.com/questions/accepting-japan-credit-bureau-%28jcb%29-payments) for more details. See [`jcb`](#jcb) below.
* `kakao_pay` - See [`kakao_pay`](#kakao_pay) below.
* `klarna` - See [`klarna`](#klarna) below.
* `konbini` - Konbini allows customers in Japan to pay for bills and online purchases at convenience stores with cash. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/konbini) for more details. See [`konbini`](#konbini) below.
* `kr_card` - See [`kr_card`](#kr_card) below.
* `link` - [Link](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link) is a payment method network. With Link, users save their payment details once, then reuse that information to pay with one click for any business on the network. See [`link`](#link) below.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `mb_way` - See [`mb_way`](#mb_way) below.
* `mobilepay` - MobilePay is a [single-use](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods#usage) card wallet payment method used in Denmark and Finland. It allows customers to [authenticate and approve](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods#customer-actions) payments using the MobilePay app. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/mobilepay) for more details. See [`mobilepay`](#mobilepay) below.
* `multibanco` - See [`multibanco`](#multibanco) below.
* `name` - Configuration name.
* `naver_pay` - See [`naver_pay`](#naver_pay) below.
* `nz_bank_account` - Stripe users in New Zealand can accept Bulk Electronic Clearing System (BECS) direct debit payments from customers with a New Zeland bank account. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/nz-bank-account) for more details. See [`nz_bank_account`](#nz_bank_account) below.
* `oxxo` - See [`oxxo`](#oxxo) below.
* `p24` - See [`p24`](#p24) below.
* `parent` - Configuration's parent configuration. Specify to create a child configuration.
* `pay_by_bank` - See [`pay_by_bank`](#pay_by_bank) below.
* `payco` - See [`payco`](#payco) below.
* `paynow` - PayNow is a Singapore-based payment method that allows customers to make a payment using their preferred app from participating banks and participating non-bank financial institutions. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paynow) for more details. See [`paynow`](#paynow) below.
* `paypal` - PayPal, a digital wallet popular with customers in Europe, allows your customers worldwide to pay using their PayPal account. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypal) for more details. See [`paypal`](#paypal) below.
* `paypay` - See [`paypay`](#paypay) below.
* `payto` - PayTo is a [real-time](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/real-time) payment method that enables customers in Australia to pay by providing their bank account details. Customers must accept a mandate authorizing you to debit their account. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payto) for more details. See [`payto`](#payto) below.
* `pix` - See [`pix`](#pix) below.
* `promptpay` - See [`promptpay`](#promptpay) below.
* `revolut_pay` - Revolut Pay, developed by Revolut, a global finance app, is a digital wallet payment method. Revolut Pay uses the customer’s stored balance or cards to fund the payment, and offers the option for non-Revolut customers to save their details after their first purchase. See [`revolut_pay`](#revolut_pay) below.
* `samsung_pay` - See [`samsung_pay`](#samsung_pay) below.
* `satispay` - See [`satispay`](#satispay) below.
* `scalapay` - See [`scalapay`](#scalapay) below.
* `sepa_debit` - See [`sepa_debit`](#sepa_debit) below.
* `sequra` - SeQura is a [single-use](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods#usage) payment method that offers customers payment terms ranging from 7-120 days. Customers are redirected from your website or app, authorize the payment with SeQura, then return to your website or app. You get [immediate notification](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods#payment-notification) of whether the payment succeeded or failed. See [`sequra`](#sequra) below.
* `sofort` - See [`sofort`](#sofort) below.
* `sunbit` - See [`sunbit`](#sunbit) below.
* `swish` - Swish is a [real-time](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/real-time) payment method popular in Sweden. It allows customers to [authenticate and approve](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods#customer-actions) payments using the Swish mobile app and the Swedish BankID mobile app. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/swish) for more details. See [`swish`](#swish) below.
* `twint` - Twint is a payment method popular in Switzerland. It allows customers to pay using their mobile phone. Check this [page](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/twint) for more details. See [`twint`](#twint) below.
* `upi` - See [`upi`](#upi) below.
* `us_bank_account` - See [`us_bank_account`](#us_bank_account) below.
* `wechat_pay` - See [`wechat_pay`](#wechat_pay) below.
* `zip` - See [`zip`](#zip) below.

<a id="acss_debit"></a>
### `acss_debit`

The `acss_debit` attribute supports:

* `available` - Whether this payment method may be offered at checkout. True if `display_preference` is `on` and the payment method's capability is active.
* `display_preference` - See [`acss_debit.display_preference`](#acss_debit.display_preference) below.

<a id="acss_debit.display_preference"></a>
### `acss_debit.display_preference`

The `acss_debit.display_preference` attribute supports:

* `overridable` - For child configs, whether or not the account's preference will be observed. If `false`, the parent configuration's default is used.
* `preference` - The account's display preference. Possible values: `none`, `off`, `on`.
* `value` - The effective display preference value. Possible values: `off`, `on`.

### `upi`

The `upi` attribute supports:

* `display_preference` - See [`upi.display_preference`](#upi.display_preference) below.

<a id="upi.display_preference"></a>
### `upi.display_preference`

The `upi.display_preference` attribute supports:

* `overridable` - For child configs, whether or not the account's preference will be observed. If `false`, the parent configuration's default is used.
* `preference` - The account's display preference. Possible values: `none`, `off`, `on`.
* `value` - The effective display preference value. Possible values: `off`, `on`.
